newsitem.title: USA: U.S., China trade officials discuss market access.
newsitem.headline: U.S., China trade officials discuss market access.

text.p: Acting U.S. Trade Representative Charlene Barshefsky met China's Vice Trade Minister Long Yongtu on Wednesday to discuss a wide range of market access issues, a USTR spokesman said.

The 45 minute meeting was part of three-days of discussions between U.S. and Chinese trade officials that also covered China's efforts to join the World Trade Organization and an agreement to curb copyright piracy.
The United States has been pressing Beijing to do more to open its markets to more American-made goods and to undertake the economic reforms necessary to become a member of the WTO.

Barshefsky has complained that Beijing has not taken serious action to move its bid to join the global trading body forward. A U.S. trade official said the discussions did not break any new ground, but served to better understand each others positions on the issues.
